<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Create an organization, catalog, namespace or collection.

Panel: [Manage](/docs/reference/cli/panels/manage/).

## Usage

```text
huron create [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                               | Description                                                                          |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [`huron create org`](#huron-create-org)               | Create an organization (Platform Admin). The API creates its directory on the share. |
| [`huron create catalog`](#huron-create-catalog)       | Create a catalog (Org Admin). The API creates its directory on the share.            |
| [`huron create namespace`](#huron-create-namespace)   | Create a namespace (Catalog Admin). The API creates its directory on the share.      |
| [`huron create collection`](#huron-create-collection) | Reserve a collection, fill its metadata, then activate it.                           |

## `huron create org`

Create an organization (Platform Admin). The API creates its directory on the share.

The service refuses this command when its configuration declares the organizations. In that
case, a storage admin prepares their directories with `huron adm provision-orgs`.

```text
huron create org [OPTIONS] NAME
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME`   | str  | Required.   |

### Options

| Option           | Type | Default | Description                        |
| ---------------- | ---- | ------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `--display-name` | str  |         | A human-readable name.             |
| `--description`  | str  |         | A description of the organization. |

## `huron create catalog`

Create a catalog (Org Admin). The API creates its directory on the share.

With `--share-group`, the API also tries to give the directory that group. If the API cannot
set the group, the storage administrator must set the group.

```text
huron create catalog [OPTIONS] NAME
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME`   | str  | Required.   |

### Options

| Option           | Type | Default | Description                                                               |
| ---------------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--org`          | str  |         | The organization of the catalog. The default is the current organization. |
| `--schema`       | str  |         | The ID of the schema to assign.                                           |
| `--display-name` | str  |         | A human-readable name.                                                    |
| `--description`  | str  |         | A description of what the catalog holds.                                  |
| `--share-group`  | str  |         | The POSIX group whose members can read the catalog directory.             |

## `huron create namespace`

Create a namespace (Catalog Admin). The API creates its directory on the share.

```text
huron create namespace [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                             |
| ------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog.namespace[.child…]`. Required. |

### Options

| Option                | Type | Default | Description                                            |
| --------------------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--allow-collections` | flag |         | Contributors may create collections in this namespace. |
| `--parents`           | flag |         | Create missing ancestor namespaces.                    |

## `huron create collection`

Reserve a collection, fill its metadata, then activate it.

The API creates the directory of the collection and writes `metadata.json` in it.

```text
huron create collection [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                         |
| ------------ | ---- | ----------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog.namespace.name`. Required. |

### Options

| Option       | Type | Default | Description                                                       |
| ------------ | ---- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--metadata` | path |         | Read the metadata from this JSON file. Do not ask for each field. |
| `--draft`    | flag |         | Stop before the CLI activates the collection.                     |
